parts.text: Namaskaram! I am planning to buy 8 cents of residential land in Aluva. What legal checks should I perform on the title deed before paying advance money?
The broker told me the plot looks like dry land with coconut trees, but the tax receipt says 'Nilam' (നിലം). Can I construct a house right away, and what are Form 5 and Form 6?
The seller is selling 5 cents of land in a Grama Panchayat with a 2-meter concrete pathway. Will I get a building permit under Kerala Panchayat Building Rules (KPBR 2019)?
The seller inherited the property through a 1980 partition deed where only the sons signed and the daughters were excluded. Is this title safe under Kerala law?
